assertion.statement: The original beta caller's V_5(A) admits the nondegenerate alternating G_F-equivariant pairing into Q_5(1) used in the determinant calculation.
assertion.objects: The same abelian surface A over the finite number field F of actual Tate restriction, and an F-defined polarization lambda:A->A^dual.
assertion.hypotheses: A is an abelian variety over F of characteristic zero. Choose an ample F-line bundle and its polarization; retain the original normalized-family Tate restriction separately.
assertion.quantifiers: For all x,y in V_5(A) and g in G_F, the pairing satisfies <gx,gy>=epsilon_5(g)<x,y>.
assertion.parameter_range: ell=5; no condition on reduction at 5 or on the 5-part of deg(lambda).
assertion.uniformity: The construction applies to this original A and F; it asserts no uniform field degree and makes no replacement of the family.
assertion.constants: Multiplier epsilon_5. Nondegeneracy is over Q_5, regardless of the integral cokernel of T_5(lambda).
assertion.normalizations: Covariant Tate modules and the roots-of-unity Tate twist Q_5(1). The dual pairing is composed in the second factor with lambda.
assertion.exceptional_cases: A principal polarization and degree prime to 5 are unnecessary. Skew symmetry is alternating in characteristic zero. Pairing supply does not establish the separate two-copy identity.
assertion.limit_order: Take compatible prime-power torsion pairings, pass to Tate modules, tensor with Q_5, and compose with the isogeny lambda.

reason: Supplies the pairing premise of ARITH-IMPORT-BETA-POLARIZATION-DETERMINANT; that accepted inline use retains responsibility for the determinant calculation.

supplier.statement: For an abelian variety A over a number field F and an F-defined polarization lambda, the canonical torsion pairings yield an F-Galois-equivariant perfect pairing of rational Tate modules V_5(A) x V_5(A^dual) into Q_5(1). Composing in the second argument with V_5(lambda) gives a nondegenerate alternating pairing on V_5(A) with values in Q_5(1).
